Kept me engaged the entire way through. The chapters are getting consistently longer, and I Iooked ahead and some of them can get up to 40k words. This one expanded the world a ton, and I think some of the best parts are flashing to our non-protagonist characters. Seeing the world from continents away adds so much. Then coming back to just seeing Erin develop and expand the inn just feels so easy and satisfying, it is a really good balance.
